messages:
alex_t: Hey team — noticed my July and August paystubs look wrong after my move. I relocated CA -> OR in May and then moved to Portugal (remote) in July. My gross pay looks split but retirement and health line items stopped after June. 

jamie_payroll: Sorry for the hassle, can you DM the employee ID? I can pull the pay runs. Did you file a non-resident state change with People Ops before the move to PT?

alex_t: Sent DM with employee id and case PR-8421. I did the state change in Brella form but I don't think international payroll was fully enabled. Also curious about W-2 vs Portuguese reporting — will I still get a W-2 for the US work months?

maria_peopleops: You should. For calendar months you were on US payroll we issue a W-2. For Portugal we'll do local payroll and provide recibos de vencimento. We need to confirm tax residency split and whether Redwood applies tax equalization.

luis_globalpay: Quick note: when someone transitions mid-year to PT, we normally stop US payroll and start PT payroll with a backfill if benefits contributions were missed. Looks like JP (benefits vendor) didn't apply July deductions — likely a timing gap during the offboarding to international payroll.

alex_t: Can you confirm if Social Security was withheld in July? I see both US FICA deductions in June but none in July, and then a PT social security line appears in August. worried this will affect annual totals.

jamie_payroll: Checking pay runs now. If FICA wasn't withheld for July we may need a retro correction on the US payroll (small supplemental payrun) or a company-side adjustment in PT depending on convention. Which months did you have PTO encashments?

alex_t: No encashments. All standard salary. No bonuses.

luis_globalpay: FYI, Portugal has social security contributions that are employer+employee. We can't double-withhold but we must reconcile the missed US FICA. We'll coordinate with tax counsel about totalization treaty; it usually means you won't pay both employee-side amounts for overlapping periods but you need the certificate/filing.

maria_peopleops: Action items: (1) Payroll to confirm whether July US payrun had FICA and benefits deductions; (2) If missing, payroll to propose retro correction and notify tax team; (3) People Ops to confirm benefits enrollment cutoff and whether health plan can be pro-rated/refunded; (4) Send alex expected docs (W-2 for US months, PT payslips, and summary of adjustments).

jamie_payroll: Confirmed: July US payroll did not process deductions — employee was flagged for international onboarding on June 30th and automatic deduction sync failed. I'll prepare a retro supplement for July FICA + benefit employee shares. 

alex_t: Appreciate it. Will that show on my year-end W-2 or as a separate correction? Want to avoid surprise tax withholding.

jamie_payroll: Retro supplement will be processed in the US payroll system and reflected as an adjustment on the final US payroll YTD. It will be included on your W-2. We'll add a note so tax notices are clear.

luis_globalpay: Also adding: we'll issue a PT payroll credit for any employee benefit overpayments if applicable. If you paid some PT contributions retroactively, we can file for a refund or offset.

maria_peopleops: I'll open a benefits exception ticket with JP and add you as the contact. Expect updates by EOD tomorrow. @jamie_payroll @luis_globalpay please CC tax_team@redwood.com on the retro plan.

jamie_payroll: Will do. payroll-bot: created payroll case PR-8421-1 and scheduled a review for 2025-07-02 14:00 UTC.

alex_t: Thanks all. One last Q: do I need to file anything personally for the split-year, or will Redwood provide the docs and notes for my tax preparer?

maria_peopleops: We'll provide a split-year summary showing US wages, PT wages, FICA withheld by month, and any retro corrections. Your tax preparer will likely need that and the totalization certificate if requested. We'll flag what needs to be handed to your CPA.

alex_t: Great — tagging this resolved for now. Please post back once PR-8421-1 is closed. :thumbsup:
